errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа списък от описания на бариери
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The horizontal (x) axis shows the percentage values, while the vertical (y) axis lists the categories of barriers.
The categories are not listed in a random order. They are sorted in descending order based on the percentage value, from bottom to top.

errors.text_span: Всички стълбове са подредени отляво надясно
errors.evidence: For a horizontal bar chart, the bars are arranged vertically (one above another). The phrase "отляво надясно" (from left to right) describes the direction of each individual bar's extension, not the arrangement of the set of bars, which is confusing.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете имат височина, пропорционална на процента, представен от всяка бариера.
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart, so the bars have 'length' (дължина) proportional to the percentage, not 'height' (височина).
The bar with the lowest value ('достъп до примери за успешно приложение на иновации') corresponds to approximately 47%, not 0%. 0% is the starting point of the axis.
The bar with the highest value ('време за подготовка на иновационни методи') reaches approximately 78%, not 90%. 90% is the maximum value on the x-axis scale, not the value of the longest bar.
